title: Customer Insights - Journeys: Outreach Optimization Agent picks email send times
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, admin enablement, consumption licensing and control operations are supported. Minor corrections should acknowledge differing Microsoft statements about cross-region storage and remove the checklist's unmatched AI prompts control instruction.

claims.claim: The roadmap associates this change with Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) and Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys.
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)", "Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys"]

claims.where: front matter: status; What's changing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development"

claims.claim: The roadmap lists General Availability and Preview release phases.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant).
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.where: front matter: platforms; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap platform is Web.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Web"]

claims.where: front matter: targetDate; What's changing; Risk assessment; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap target is April CY2027, described as a target rather than a commitment.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "April CY2027"

claims.claim: The roadmap preview date is July CY2026.
claims.quote: "previewDate": "July CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap record was modified at 2026-10-22T22:58:40.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Outreach Optimization Agent is an AI-powered journey step that chooses marketing email send times.
claims.quote: Outreach Optimization Agent is an AI-powered journey step in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys that optimizes when your marketing emails are sent.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: A maker adds the agent to a journey like another step and it handles scheduling.
claims.quote: You add Outreach Optimization Agent to a customer journey like any other step, and the agent handles scheduling from there.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The maker selects one or more email messages to send.
claims.quote: When configuring the step, select one or more email messages.

claims.claim: The roadmap says the agent builds a baseline messaging plan from historical engagement.
claims.quote: Outreach Optimization Agent automatically creates a baseline messaging plan for your audience by analyzing overall historical engagement patterns

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: The roadmap describes adapting timing and cadence or exiting the plan as signals and goal progress change.
claims.quote: The agent continuously monitors incoming signals, including engagement and non-responsiveness, and adjusts follow-up timing and cadence, or exits the plan based on whether the goal is progressing or has been achieved.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes quiet times as a hard constraint.
claims.quote: The agent enforces quiet time settings as a hard constraint, ensuring that messages are never sent outside approved communication windows

claims.claim: The agent and AI Hub documentation describe a preview subject to change.
claims.quote:
[This article is prerelease documentation and is subject to change.]
This is a preview feature.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The agent uses aggregated organizational historical email opens and clicks to identify peak engagement times.
claims.quote: It accesses your organization's historical interaction data, such as when past emails were opened or clicked, to identify general patterns of peak engagement across your audience.

claims.claim: The agent uses a generic fallback strategy if historical engagement data is unavailable.
claims.quote: If historical engagement data isn't yet available (for example, for a first-time user), the agent uses a generic fallback strategy so your emails are still sent at a reasonable time.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Multi-email sequences have goals of all emails sent, any link clicked, or selected links clicked.
claims.quote:
When using multiple emails, choose one of three goal criteria:
All emails are sent
Any link in any email is clicked
Selected links are clicked

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The maker specifies an end date before which all selected emails must be sent.
claims.quote: The end date defines the latest point in time by which the agent can send emails. The agent schedules all selected emails at optimal times, but ensures that all sends occur before this date.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: The preview agent page says remaining emails are sent even if the sequence goal is met early.
claims.quote: If the goal is met before all emails have been sent, the agent continues to send the remaining emails in the sequence. It doesn't cancel queued messages.

claims.claim: The agent records the goal as achieved when its condition is satisfied.
claims.quote: However, it records the goal as achieved at the point the condition was satisfied

claims.where: summary; What's changing: AI Hub comparison
claims.claim: AI Hub separately describes analyzing engagement history and real-time signals to adjust timing, frequency and follow-up.
claims.quote: It analyzes engagement history and real-time signals to adjust message timing, frequency, and follow-up behavior.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: The agent page does not describe the roadmap's early exit from the messaging plan.
claims.quote: Searched: "Outreach Optimization Agent" "exit" "general availability"; opened outreach-optimization-agent and ai-hub. The agent page instead says remaining emails continue after the goal is met.

claims.where: summary; licensing.notes; Why it matters; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Using Outreach Optimization Agent consumes Copilot credits.
claims.quote: Use of Outreach Optimization Agent consumes Copilot credits.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Scope; rationales
claims.claim: The feature requires admin enablement rather than arriving usable without admin action.
claims.quote: To use AI agents in Customer Insights – Journeys, a tenant administrator must first enable AI agents at the tenant level in the Power Platform Admin Center.

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Copilot Studio capacity, Move data across regions and AI prompts are required prerequisites before enabling the agent.
claims.quote:
The following prerequisites must be reviewed and accepted:
Microsoft Copilot Studio capacity
Move data across regions
AI prompts

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft says agent data might be processed and stored outside the user's primary region.
claims.quote: This means agent data might be processed and stored in regions outside the user's primary region, depending on service and infrastructure availability.
claims.fix: After this sentence, add: 'The general Power Platform data-movement page separately says this process does not log, store, or retain inputs or outputs (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/geographical-availability-copilot).'

claims.claim: AI Hub is available to users with the Admin role by default.
claims.quote: AI Hub is available to users with the Admin role by default.

claims.claim: Custom roles need agent settings permissions for msdynmkt_agentsettings.
claims.quote: If you use custom roles and permissions, add agent settings permissions for the msdynmkt_agentsettings entity.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described which identity this agent uses when sending.
claims.quote: Searched: "Outreach Optimization Agent" "identity" "audit" and Outreach Optimization Agent run identity send audit decisions approval; opened agent, AI Hub and responsible AI FAQ pages. No sending identity is specified.

claims.claim: The Learn agent page describes no per-send approval.
claims.quote: Searched: "Outreach Optimization Agent" "approval" "generally available"; opened outreach-optimization-agent and faqs-outreach-optimization-agent. Setup selects emails, goals and end date; no per-send approval is described.

claims.claim: The agent supports email only.
claims.quote:
Current limitations of Outreach Optimization Agent include:
Email-only channel support.

claims.claim: The agent honors configured quiet times.
claims.quote: Even if historical data suggests a high-engagement window outside permitted hours (for example, late at night), the agent won't schedule emails during quiet-time periods.

claims.claim: The agent honors contact point consent.
claims.quote: If a contact has opted out of email communication on a specific address, no email is sent to that address.

claims.claim: Quiet times can cover up to 21 consecutive days.
claims.quote: The combined quiet times effect (both quiet dates and quiet hours) must stay within the 21 day maximum.

claims.claim: Microsoft says preview features are not meant for production use.
claims.quote: Preview features aren’t meant for production use and might have restricted functionality.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Losing acceptance of a mandatory prerequisite automatically disables all enabled agents.
claims.quote:
If any mandatory prerequisite is no longer accepted in the Power Platform Admin Center:
All enabled agents are automatically disabled.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: Disabling AI agents in the Power Platform admin center immediately disables all active agents, not just Outreach Optimization Agent.
claims.quote:
If a tenant administrator disables AI agents in the Power Platform Admin Center:
All active agents are immediately disabled.
New agents can't be created or configured.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Prepaid Copilot Studio message pack capacity is a billing option for Journeys AI capabilities.
claims.quote: Prepaid capacity: Uses Copilot Studio message pack subscriptions, which are a licensing option for Microsoft Copilot Studio that you purchase in advance.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go charges for the actual messages consumed by agents during the month.
claims.quote: Pay-as-you-go: Charges for the actual number of messages consumed by agents during the month.

claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go credit usage can be billed to an Azure subscription.
claims.quote: By using a billing plan, administrators can track and bill Copilot Studio credit capacity usage directly to an Azure subscription on a pay-as-you-go basis.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Copilot Studio capacity must be allocated to the environment for Journeys AI agents.
claims.quote: Before using AI agents, administrators need to make sure enough Copilot Studio capacity is allocated to the environment. Capacity allocation is managed in the Power Platform Admin Center.

claims.claim: If no overage source is enabled, an environment can consume only its allocated prepaid credits.
claims.quote: If no overage source is enabled, the environment can consume only its allocated prepaid credits.

claims.claim: Experiences requiring credits can stop working after the allocation is exhausted.
claims.quote: Experiences that require credits can stop working after that allocation is exhausted.

claims.claim: Customer Insights - Journeys is licensed per tenant.
claims.quote: Customer Insights - Journeys is licensed per tenant, and each tenant is priced based on the number of interacted people stored in your database.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published an agent-specific credit rate per email, contact or decision, and the cited billing rate table has no entry for it.
claims.quote: Searched: Outreach Optimization Agent Copilot credits rate per email pricing; opened agent, AI Hub prerequisites and requirements-messages-management, and searched its text for Outreach, Journeys and Dynamics. No agent-specific rate or unit was found.

claims.claim: The agent page lists AI Hub enablement as its prerequisite, and the agent and AI Hub prerequisite lists name no Customer Insights - Journeys license.
claims.quote: Searched: Outreach Optimization Agent Customer Insights Journeys AI Hub prerequisites; opened outreach-optimization-agent, ai-hub and ai-hub-prerequisites and read their prerequisite lists. None names a Customer Insights - Journeys license.

claims.claim: Learn points to the Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Copilot Studio product availability list for supported regions.
claims.quote: AI agents in Customer Insights - Journeys are available in the geographical regions listed in Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Copilot Studio product availability.

claims.claim: AI Hub requires Customer Insights - Journeys update 1.1.65002.153.
claims.quote: AI Hub is available as part of the 1.1.65002.153 update. To use AI Hub, navigate to Settings > Versions and upgrade to 1.1.65002.153.

claims.claim: The agent operates within predefined scenarios with fixed goals and exit conditions.
claims.quote: Operation limited to predefined scenarios with fixed goals and exit conditions.

claims.where: Scope; Open questions: generally available version
claims.claim: Learn does not describe rollout beyond the preview or confirm GA prerequisites and enablement behavior.
claims.quote: Searched: "Outreach Optimization Agent" "exit" "general availability" and "Outreach Optimization Agent" "approval" "generally available"; opened agent, AI Hub and prerequisites pages. They describe preview, not a GA rollout or final prerequisites.

claims.claim: Use AI agents is at Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys > AI agents > Use AI agents.
claims.quote:
Go to Power Platform Admin Center > Copilot > Settings.
Scroll to the Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Journeys section.
Select AI agents.
Set Use AI agents to On for the selected environment or environment group.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for the Journeys Use AI agents switch.
claims.quote: Searched: Customer Insights Journeys Use AI agents enable disable PowerShell API AI Hub msdynmkt_agentsettings; opened ai-hub and ai-hub-prerequisites. Search results document UI setup, not an API for this switch.

claims.where: controls[0].scope and note; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The Use AI agents setting can be set for an environment or environment group.
claims.quote: Set Use AI agents to On for the selected environment or environment group.

claims.claim: AI Hub is under Settings, and agent activation follows AI Hub > Add and manage agents > Add an agent > Outreach Optimization Agent > Overview tab > Enable.
claims.quote:
In AI Hub, select Add and manage agents.
Select Add an agent and choose Outreach Optimization Agent.
In the Overview tab, review how the agent works.
To activate the agent, select Enable.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for enabling or disabling this individual agent in AI Hub.
claims.quote: Searched: Outreach Optimization Agent enable disable API msdynmkt_agentsettings; "msdynmkt_agentsettings" API enable; opened ai-hub. Results for msdyn_agentsetting concern a different table, not a documented API for this agent's switch.

claims.claim: Capacity management is at Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Manage Copilot Credits.
claims.quote:
On the navigation pane, select Licensing.
In the Licensing pane, under Products, select Copilot Studio.
Select the Summary tab.
Under the Copilot Studio heading, select Manage Copilot Credits or Manage sessions.

claims.claim: The Power Platform API accepts the printed allocationsV2 PUT with version 2024-10-01, environment scope, MCSMessages quantity and TenantPool enforcement rule.
Disabling TenantPool disables tenant-pool draw, not every possible overage source.
claims.quote:
Select Draw from the available capacity in my tenant to let the environment use unallocated prepaid capacity from the tenant pool.
Select Bill to my pay-as-you-go billing plan to let the environment continue usage through the selected billing plan.

claims.claim: A published environment-group rule can lock tenant-pool draw and cause individual updates to fail with TenantPoolLockedByPolicy.
claims.quote: Updates through the Power Platform admin center, Power Platform API, or administration SDKs are rejected with the TenantPoolLockedByPolicy error.

claims.claim: Move data across regions is at Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Generative AI features > Edit > Move data across regions.
claims.quote:
In the navigation pane, select Manage.
Select Environments.
On the Environments page, select the target environment.
In the environment details page, locate the Generative AI features card and select Edit.
Select the Move data across regions checkbox.

claims.claim: Microsoft.PowerApps.Administration.PowerShell provides Set-PowerPlatformGenerativeAiSettings with EnvironmentName and CrossGeoDataMovement $true to allow cross-geography movement.
claims.quote:
Set-PowerPlatformGenerativeAiSettings -EnvironmentName 00aa00aa-bb11-cc22-dd33-44ee44ee44ee -CrossGeoDataMovement $true -BingSearch $true -Microsoft365Services $true
Sets the generative AI settings allowing for cross-geography data movement, Bing Search, and Microsoft 365 services

claims.claim: The cross-region checkbox may not appear in regions with full in-region capacity.
claims.quote: If your environment is in a region that has full in region capacity, the Move data across regions checkbox doesn't appear.

claims.claim: Quiet times is at Customer Insights - Journeys > Settings > Customer engagement > Quiet times.
claims.quote: To set up quiet times, go to Settings > Customer engagement > Quiet times.

claims.claim: A POST to the Dataverse msdynmkt_quiettimesettings entity set creates a Quiet Time Setting record with caller-supplied configuration.
claims.quote:
Create Event: True | POST /msdynmkt_quiettimesettings See Create
EntitySetName | msdynmkt_quiettimesettings
These columns/attributes return true for either IsValidForCreate or IsValidForUpdate

claims.claim: Messages use quiet times through the compliance profile associated with them.
claims.quote: Once a quiet time has been added to a compliance profile, all messages designated with that compliance profile respect the quiet times configured.

claims.claim: AI Hub can disable an individual agent in the selected environment.
claims.quote:
In AI Hub, go to Add and manage agents.
Select the agent.
Set the agent status to Disabled.
Once disabled, the agent is no longer available for use in the selected environment.

claims.claim: The AI prompts prerequisite is configured at Power Platform admin center > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features.
claims.quote:
In the admin center, select Environments > [select an environment] > Settings > Product > Features.
On the Features settings page under AI Builder, enable the AI prompts toggle.

claims.claim: An environment-group rule can govern AI prompts availability.
claims.quote: If your environment is part of an environment group, you can also govern the AI prompts feature availability through the AI prompts environment group rule.

claims.claim: The Generative AI settings environment rule controls Move data across regions at scale.
claims.quote:
Is it possible to modify the "Move data across regions" checkbox at scale across all my environments?
Yes, you can use the Generative AI settings environment rule to control this at scale.

claims.claim: Capacity API changes require Power Platform Administrator, Global Administrator or equivalent licensing and capacity permissions.
claims.quote: Sign in as a user with the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.where: Governance controls; Open questions: monthly limit
claims.claim: The reviewed documentation does not confirm whether the admin center's monthly agent-limit list includes this agent.
claims.quote: Searched: "Outreach Optimization Agent" "monthly" "limits"; opened AI Hub and manage-copilot-studio-messages-capacity. AI Hub links capacity management, but neither page identifies this agent as listed in Manage Agents.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described where this agent's send-time decisions are recorded for audit.
claims.quote: Searched: "Outreach Optimization Agent" "identity" "audit"; opened agent, AI Hub and responsible AI FAQ pages. None identifies an audit record of send-time decisions; generic Entra audit excerpts do not establish this agent's implementation.

claims.claim: Copilot Studio licensing reports show credit consumption and environment capacity status.
claims.quote: The Environments tab provides details on the Copilot Studio credit capacity consumed per environment

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Every control the governance checklist asks readers to check has a controls-table row.
claims.quote:
Re-check the prerequisites after any change to data movement or AI prompts settings
The five controls rows cover agent availability, agent enablement, capacity, data movement and quiet times, but not AI prompts.
claims.fix: The After rollout checklist names AI prompts without a corresponding controls row. Narrow that bullet to: 'Re-check the Move data across regions prerequisite after changing data movement settings, because losing a mandatory prerequisite disables all enabled agents.'

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and cost; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Consumption licensing and variable cost correctly describe the documented Copilot credit meter.
claims.quote: Use of Outreach Optimization Agent consumes Copilot credits.
